data.standardized_narrative: Using the syndicate's gross claims development triangle, older underwriting years (<=2013) show a net adverse prior-year movement of USD 33.8m (approximately 1.05% of opening gross claims outstanding of USD 3,213.5m). The movement reflects a mix of adverse development (notably on 2013) partially offset by favourable development (notably on 2012); the syndicate reports no major loss events in 2015 and notes generally that claims experience was in line with expectations.
raw_causal_phrases: Our overall claims experience in 2015 has been in line with expectations.
An increase in the attritional loss ratio from rating pressures and a change in business mix was offset by the absence of major claims for the Syndicate in 2015.
Adjustments to the amounts of the claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in the profit and loss account for the period in which the adjustments are made.

Whilst the Directors consider that the estimate of claims outstanding is fairly calculated on the basis of the information currently available to them, there is inherent uncertainty in relation to the ultimate liability which will vary as a result of subsequent information and events.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (USD 33.8m) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (Note 9) by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2015 and 2014) and summing the diagonal changes for 2011-2013. No explicit single-sentence gross prior-year movement statement was found in the narrative; the reconciliation note contains 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting years' rows but these represent claims-incurred movements in that reconciliation. All amounts are reported in the native currency (USD millions) though field names use '_gbp_m' per requested schema. Confidence in the triangle-based PYD calculation is 0.8 per instructions.
